description: Turns one of the business's Scanners on or off, as the On switch in Automations > Scanners does. A Scanner is only ever on or off (never a trial mode). scanner_id comes from read('scanners'). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: set_scanner_on
title: Turn a Scanner on or off
